name: Flow POS – Point of Sale for WooCommerce
author: racmanuel.dev

sections.description:
Flow POS is a modern Point of Sale (POS) system for WooCommerce that transforms your WordPress store into a powerful in-store sales solution.

Sell in physical locations using your existing WooCommerce products, customers and inventory — all fully synchronized in real time.

Built with performance and flexibility in mind, Flow POS is designed for both business owners and developers, offering a clean POS experience and a powerful architecture with hooks and extensibility.

Website: https://racmanuel.dev/plugins-wordpress/flow-pos/

👉 Try it on your own store or integrate it into your workflow in minutes.

Why Flow POS?

Unlike traditional POS plugins, Flow POS focuses on:

  • ⚡ Speed and smooth checkout experience
  • 🔄 Real-time WooCommerce synchronization
  • 🧩 Modular architecture for scalability
  • 🧑‍💻 Developer-friendly (hooks & filters)
  • 🏪 Multi-store and multi-register ready

Whether you’re running a retail store or building solutions for clients, Flow POS adapts to your needs.

Core Features (Free)

  • 🛒 Full POS checkout with WooCommerce order creation
  • 💳 Multiple and split payments in a single sale
  • 🧾 Cash register sessions (open / close tracking)
  • 👤 Customer search and on-the-fly creation
  • ⏸️ Suspended carts for paused transactions
  • 📦 Real-time stock validation
  • 📊 Sales summary after each transaction
  • 📈 POS dashboard with operational KPIs
  • 🎨 Customizable register interface (colors & UI)
  • 🔌 Developer-ready architecture with hooks and filters

Pro Features

Buy today and support the evolution of Flow POS.

Flow POS already lets you start with a modern POS experience, and the vision is to evolve it into a complete platform for daily store operations.

Limited-time early adopter offer: Single Site Lifetime access for $289.99 USD. Applies to the Single Site plan.

Currently Available

  • Multi-store support
  • Multi-register support
  • Modern POS interface
  • Optimized sales workflow
  • Multiple payments
  • Split payments
  • Discounts
  • Fees
  • Shipping
  • Suspended carts
  • Cash register closing
  • Sound feedback
  • Per-register color customization
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Inventory synchronization
  • Ticket printing and customization

Recently Added

  • ✅ Product scanning with webcam (v1.0.2)

In Development (Target: Mid-2026)

  • Order management from the POS
  • Customer management from the POS
  • Inventory management from the POS
  • Sales reports from the POS
  • Cash flow reports from the POS
  • Hooks and filters documentation
  • A more complete operations experience

Throughout Q1 and Q2 2026, we will progressively release new capabilities that will take the system to a much more complete level.

In v1.0.2 we already delivered barcode scanning with webcam and real-time stock updates via SSE.

Between Q1 and Q2 2026, you will be able to start using tools such as order, customer, and inventory management directly from the POS, along with advanced reports, ticket printing, and further scanning capabilities.

These features will be enabled gradually so you can adopt them as they evolve while keeping your operation always active.

Built for Developers

Flow POS is not just a POS system — it’s a platform.

  • Clean and modular architecture
  • Extensible via hooks and filters
  • Compatible with WooCommerce workflows
  • Designed for customization and integrations

Developer docs (Hooks & Filters): https://racmanuel.dev/docs/flow-pos-point-of-sale-for-woocommerce/hooks-and-filters/

Perfect for agencies, SaaS builders and advanced WooCommerce projects.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • WooCommerce installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Flow POS in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does Flow POS require WooCommerce?

Yes. Flow POS extends WooCommerce and uses it to manage products, customers and orders.

Can multiple cashiers use the POS at the same time?

Yes. Flow POS supports multiple registers and concurrent POS sessions.

Are POS sales stored as WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Every transaction is automatically created as a WooCommerce order.

Is Flow POS free?

Yes. The core plugin is 100% free. The Pro version is currently in development, with advanced features rolling out progressively throughout 2026.

Does Flow POS support multi-store and multi-register operations?

Yes. Flow POS is designed to support multi-store and multi-register workflows for growing retail operations.

Can I accept multiple and split payments in one sale?

Yes. Flow POS supports multiple payment methods and split payments within a single transaction.

Does Flow POS sync inventory with WooCommerce in real time?

Yes. Stock changes are synchronized with WooCommerce so your POS and online store stay aligned.

Can I pause a sale and resume it later?

Yes. You can use suspended carts to pause a transaction and continue it when the customer is ready.

Can I apply discounts, fees, and shipping from the POS?

Yes. Flow POS includes support for discounts, additional charges, and shipping adjustments during checkout.

Does Flow POS track cash register openings and closings?

Yes. Cash session workflows include register open/close tracking for daily operations.

Do POS sales affect WooCommerce reporting and order data?

Yes. Because POS transactions are saved as WooCommerce orders, they are reflected in your WooCommerce order and reporting flow.

Do I need special hardware to start using Flow POS?

No special hardware is required to get started. You can begin with your current WordPress + WooCommerce setup and add peripherals as needed.

What is included in Flow POS free today?

The free version includes core POS checkout, WooCommerce order creation, split payments, suspended carts, cash session handling, and inventory synchronization.

When will Pro features currently in development be available?

New Pro capabilities are planned for progressive release across Q1 2026 and Q2 2026, with broader operational depth targeted by mid-2026.

How will new Pro features roll out during 2026?

Features will be enabled gradually so stores can adopt improvements step by step without disrupting day-to-day operations.

Is there a limited-time lifetime price?

Yes. A limited-time early adopter offer is available: Single Site Lifetime access for $289.99 USD. Applies to the Single Site plan.

Where can developers find hooks and filters documentation?

Developer docs are available here: https://racmanuel.dev/docs/flow-pos-point-of-sale-for-woocommerce/hooks-and-filters/
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • New: Auto-flush rewrite rules for POS and login routes
  • New: PWA home screen access support (improved service worker)
  • New: iOS meta tags for add-to-home-screen experience
  • Fixed: 404 error on POS route after permalink changes
  • Fixed: 404 error on login route after permalink changes
  • Improved: Service worker minimal fetch handler for PWA installability

1.0.2

  • New barcode scanner with camera (html5-qrcode integration)
  • Scanner sound feedback on barcode detection
  • Admin dashboard panel with KPIs overview
  • POS columns and filters in WooCommerce orders list
  • Custom POS order status for pending carts
  • Service worker and manifest for PWA support
  • Stock validation with FOR UPDATE for race condition prevention
  • Stock error toast notifications in cart and checkout
  • Server-side cart cleanup cron for abandoned orders
  • Admin panel access button from POS sidebar
  • Improved cart suspension with store validation
  • Fixed: stock release when voiding suspended carts
  • Fixed: discount, fee and shipping validation with metadata persistence
  • Fixed: register theme color persistence
  • Fixed: customer display reset after payment
  • Dead code cleanup and unused method removal
  • Concurrency fixes in checkout and cart operations
  • Database schema improvements in activator

1.0.1

  • README updates (Pro roadmap, expanded FAQs, and links)
  • Add add-ons on code for ready production

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • POS checkout interface
  • Split payments support
  • Cash register sessions
  • Suspended carts
  • Customer management
